outcome: Craniofacial clinical manifestations associated with Moebius syndrome
Frequency of prenatal exposure to misoprostol
cohort: 140 patients with Moebius syndrome in Colombia
finding: Prenatal exposure to misoprostol may be linked to Moebius syndrome, but it does not appear to increase the number of associated craniofacial malformations.
followup_time: Average age of 8.4 years (range: 29 days to 48 years)
